remarks: Welcome to this light and airy, updated end-unit townhouse, located in the Nor-West Complex. Upon entering the sun-filled home, you will notice the bright, airy feel, featuring modern finishings with warmth and style throughout. The semi-open concept offers a spacious dining area with an open flow to the living room with expansive windows and a slider door to the tranquil deck, allowing for a seamless flow for entertaining. The first level is complete with a spacious kitchen with breakfast nook, half bath, and a large storage closet. The dramatic iron staircase leads you to the second level, which hosts the primary bedroom with large windows, and double closet. Completing the second floor is another bedroom with double closet, updated full bath, and easily accessible laundry. This home offers a perfect blend of comfort and location. Explore the local vibrant vibe Norwalk has to offer and neighboring towns like Westport with shops and Compo Beach.   Centrally located to many highways, stores, the SoNo Mall and so much more. Don't miss this move-in-ready gem
